text: Based on the evidence, there has been a tree-cover loss of approximately 13.5 hectares (3.91% of the property) on the rural property in question during 2025. The area affected was predominantly native forest, with a 98% agreement on the forest cover from the JRC GFC2020 data. However, it's important to note that this evidence does not confirm if the change is persistent, the cause of the change, or if it was legal or authorized. Further corroboration and a later year of observation are needed to establish these details..
